text: This is probably the town the Lixis once lived\nin...
Ruins...but this place isn't old enough to be\ncalled that...I wonder how long it has been since\npeople left this place...
We live in Movere Silva, so we're not sure about\nthat.
But we know that this place was already\nuninhabited before Toram and your world\ncollided...
What? Then it must have been a really long time!!\nThat means the Lixis are pretty much extinct...
Looks like we're not welcome here...
Oh well, I guess we're gonna have to make a break\nfor it!
Hey, you really dunno how to be cool, do you?\nHm...their body color is different...
They seem more powerful compared to the ones we\nsaw earlier...It's dangerous if you let your\nguard down, be careful!!
Yeah...\nWe've cleared out the Coenubias here for now...
Looks like it's not over yet...\nI bet there are Lixis in their final forms in\nthere.
Hey...The final form of Corroded Lixi...\nIs it the creature we saw in Lunagent...?
Judging by your reaction, it must be quite\ndangerous, huh?
You tell Zianga about the battle against the\ncrystal monster you encountered in Lunagent...
I see, so it's tough, huh? I might not stand a\nchance against it, but I'll give it my all...\nLet's go!
